Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: one standalone full playable landscape background map for Vault Wars, a Godot Android fixed-camera game. Input image 1 is a REFERENCE for camera angle, high-detail polished painted storybook fantasy style, symmetric balanced gameplay and three horizontal lanes; do not copy its patch glitches or minimap. Primary request: DWARVEN VAULTS: monumental carved bronze-and-stone dwarven fortress vault at each side, blue banners at left/red at right. Mountain citadel with rune-carved stone paths, a narrow central turquoise subterranean canal and three low flat stone bridges, warm forge braziers and enormous distant carved statues kept outside playable lanes. Gold brass trim, slate stone, cool teal and amber light. Both fortresses completely visible.
COMPOSITION: render a clean new extremely wide full map, 2304x1024 landscape approximately 2.26:1. Ground plane must fill canvas, no sky horizon. Orthographic elevated top-down 2.5D painting. Three EMPTY, level, continuous traversable paths running horizontally across the entire scene: foot lines at exactly 31%, 54%, 77% image height; bridge centers exactly 50% image width at each path. Each path clear corridor at least 10% image height. Vault contact points x6.25% and x93.75% at middle-path y54%. Let the upper and lower paths connect visibly to the same vault complexes at edges. Never create extra paths or block them with scenery. Whole left and right bases contained with margin, no cropped towers. Left and right use the SAME architectural faction style and equal footprint; small blue/red team flags differentiate sides. Central stream/rift narrow 8% canvas width so units walk across bridges. Top left HUD-safe area not baked into art. Lighting supports tiny foreground sprites: paths medium-light and low contrast, rich detail only outside corridors. Polished epic magical fantasy game illustration, crisp coherent stonework, readable silhouette, cohesive physically believable perspective. CONSTRAINTS: no text, labels, typography, buttons, UI, minimap, arrows, borders, logos, watermark, characters, units, gold piles on paths, repeated pasted rectangles, panels or collage. This is exactly one clean complete map background.
